pairs.registryProposal: drift-correction's status rule states only the zeroing direction (an offset brought to zero reads as placed). Code can satisfy that sentence and never show drift at all, as here; the rule should also say a non-zero offset outside tolerance must read as drifting unless it is authored as intentional.
